summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature by reading and editing files only; nothing was run, installed, or committed. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" formatting entry and a Control.title classmethod with a docstring; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, writing the control only when is_terminal is true, with the Google-style docstring covering the title-reset caveat and the meaning of True; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch that calls term.set_title with the code's second item; CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (skipped on Windows) in tests/test_console.py, test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only via the file's existing marker). Not verified: Black, mypy, and pytest were not run; line lengths were checked by hand against 88 columns. No commit was made.
